pregnancy.notes: Pre-hire pregnancy questions are direct sex discrimination; applicants have an established right to lie. Column should not appear in recruitment data.

religion.notes: Forbidden as a pre-hire question for ordinary employers; tendency employers (church, party, union) may inquire if the belief is essential to the role.

health.notes: Pre-employment health questions only when directly job-essential (e.g. pilot). Generic health columns are not lawful.

disability.notes: Severely disabled status may be asked post-contract for the §164 SGB IX framework.

criminal_record.notes: Permitted only for job-essential roles (e.g. banking executive, childcare). Generic collection unlawful.

ethnicity.notes: Equality monitoring as a German concept is narrower than UK/US; works council co-determination (§87 BetrVG) applies.

family_status_planning.legal_basis: AGG §11; BAG case law on family-planning questions
